rules.rationale: Sepsis is a condition requiring specific fluid resuscitation strategies.
rules.citation: For adults with sepsis [SNOMED: 91302008] or septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007], we recommend using crystalloids as first-line fluid for resuscitation [SNOMED: 304252001].

rules.rationale: Septic shock is a condition requiring specific fluid and vasopressor strategies.
rules.citation: For adults with sepsis [SNOMED: 91302008] or septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007], we recommend using crystalloids as first-line fluid for resuscitation [SNOMED: 304252001].

rules.rationale: First-line fluid resuscitation for sepsis is crystalloids.
rules.citation: For adults with sepsis [SNOMED: 91302008] or septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007], we recommend using crystalloids as first-line fluid for resuscitation [SNOMED: 304252001].

rules.rationale: Balanced crystalloids are suggested over normal saline for sepsis resuscitation.
rules.citation: For adults with sepsis [SNOMED: 91302008] or septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007], we suggest using balanced [SNOMED: 78933003] crystalloids instead of normal saline [SNOMED: 70379000] for resuscitation [SNOMED: 304252001].

rules.rationale: Albumin may be considered after large volumes of crystalloids in sepsis.
rules.citation: For adults with sepsis [SNOMED: 91302008] or septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007], we suggest using albumin [SNOMED: 52454007] in patients who received large volumes of crystalloids.

rules.rationale: Starches are recommended against for resuscitation in sepsis.
rules.citation: For adults with sepsis [SNOMED: 91302008] or septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007], we recommend against using starches for resuscitation [SNOMED: 304252001].

rules.rationale: Gelatin is recommended against for resuscitation in sepsis.
rules.citation: For adults with sepsis [SNOMED: 91302008] and septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007], we suggest against using gelatin [SNOMED: 373531009] for resuscitation [SNOMED: 304252001].

rules.citation: For adults with sepsis [SNOMED: 91302008] or septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007], we suggest using albumin [SNOMED: 52454007] in patients who received large volumes of crystalloids.

rules.rationale: Starches are recommended against for resuscitation in septic shock.
rules.citation: For adults with sepsis [SNOMED: 91302008] or septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007], we recommend against using starches for resuscitation [SNOMED: 304252001].

rules.rationale: Gelatin is recommended against for resuscitation in septic shock.
rules.citation: For adults with sepsis [SNOMED: 91302008] and septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007], we suggest against using gelatin [SNOMED: 373531009] for resuscitation [SNOMED: 304252001].

rules.rationale: Norepinephrine is the first-line vasopressor for septic shock.
rules.citation: For adults with septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007], we recommend using norepinephrine [SNOMED: 45555007] as the first-line agent [SNOMED: 260872001] over other vasopressors [SNOMED: 870406003].

rules.rationale: Vasopressin may be added to norepinephrine for septic shock with inadequate MAP.
rules.citation: For adults with septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007] on norepinephrine [SNOMED: 45555007] with inadequate [SNOMED: 71978007] mean arterial pressure [SNOMED: 1285244000] levels, we suggest adding vasopressin instead of escalating the dose [SNOMED: 408102007] of norepinephrine [SNOMED: 45555007].

rules.rationale: Epinephrine may be added to norepinephrine and vasopressin for septic shock with inadequate MAP.
rules.citation: For adults with septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007] and inadequate [SNOMED: 71978007] mean arterial pressure [SNOMED: 1285244000] levels despite norepinephrine [SNOMED: 45555007] and vasopressin, we suggest adding epinephrine [SNOMED: 387362001].

rules.rationale: Terlipressin is recommended against for septic shock.
rules.citation: For adults with septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007], we suggest against using terlipressin [SNOMED: 395899009].

rules.rationale: Dobutamine or epinephrine may be added to norepinephrine for septic shock with cardiac dysfunction and persistent hypoperfusion.
rules.citation: For adults with septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007] and cardiac [SNOMED: 80891009] dysfunction [SNOMED: 386585008] with persistent hypoperfusion [SNOMED: 264533003] despite adequate volume status and arterial blood pressure [SNOMED: 386534000], we suggest either adding dobutamine [SNOMED: 387145002] to norepinephrine [SNOMED: 45555007] or using epinephrine [SNOMED: 387362001] alone.

rules.rationale: Levosimendan is recommended against for septic shock with cardiac dysfunction and persistent hypoperfusion.
rules.citation: For adults with septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007] and cardiac [SNOMED: 80891009] dysfunction [SNOMED: 386585008] with persistent hypoperfusion [SNOMED: 264533003] despite adequate volume status and arterial blood pressure [SNOMED: 386534000], we suggest against using levosimendan [SNOMED: 442795003].

rules.rationale: Invasive arterial blood pressure monitoring is suggested for septic shock.
rules.citation: For adults with septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007], we suggest invasive [SNOMED: 10179008] monitoring of arterial blood pressure [SNOMED: 386534000] over non-invasive [SNOMED: 22762002] monitoring, as soon as practical and if resources are available.

rules.rationale: Vasopressors should be started peripherally for septic shock if central access is delayed.
rules.citation: For adults with septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007], we suggest starting vasopressors [SNOMED: 870406003] peripherally to restore mean arterial pressure [SNOMED: 1285244000] rather than delaying initiation [SNOMED: 312009002] until a central venous [SNOMED: 29092000] access is secured.

rules.rationale: In septic shock with cardiac dysfunction and persistent hypoperfusion despite adequate volume status and blood pressure, adding dobutamine to norepinephrine (or using epinephrine alone) is suggested.
rules.citation: For adults with septic shock and cardiac dysfunction with persistent hypoperfusion despite adequate volume status and arterial blood pressure, we suggest either adding dobutamine to norepinephrine or using epinephrine alone.
